summary: Traditional Muay Thai gym in Pattaya run by Sudsakorn Klinmee, offering daily, weekly and monthly training for beginners, fighters and weight loss.

facts.label: Head of gym
facts.quote: This is the gym of SUDSAKORN KLINMEE

facts.label: Session times
facts.value: Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 11:00 and 16:00 to 19:00

facts.label: Day price
facts.value: 400 baht for one session a day

facts.label: Weekly price
facts.value: 1800 baht for one session a day, 3000 baht for two

facts.label: Monthly price
facts.value: 6000 baht for one session a day

facts.label: Monthly price, 2 sessions
facts.value: 9000 baht for two sessions a day

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: Beginner friendly: discover the culture of Muay Thai
